name: What is the average cost of converting a garage into a home office?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of converting a garage into a home office?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage-to-home-office conversion varies widely depending on factors like the garage's existing condition, desired finishes, electrical upgrades, insulation needs, and HVAC integration. Basic conversions might start from around $15,000, while more elaborate projects with premium materials, custom built-ins, or significant structural changes can exceed $30,000. We provide a detailed, itemized quote after assessing your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a garage-to-home-office conversion typically range from $15,000 to over $30,000, based on project scope and finishes.
